violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. CFM not present at the beginning of the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program.CFM arrived 15 min after

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink. Observed hand sink next to grill with no paper towels
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing.CFM provided paper towels

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Chlorine Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the chlorine-based sanitizing solution was observed to be at a concentration less than what is required for effective sanitization of food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils. Observed the sanitizing solution in the 3-compartment sink with a concentration of 5 ppm total chlorine.
violations.corrective_action: A chlorine-based sanitizing solution shall have a minimum concentration of at least 50 to 200 ppm total chlorine when tested using the appropriate test kit. CFM provided new gallon of chlorine and correct the sanitizer concentration to 100 ppm

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Observed raw chicken, raw lamb, raw beef patties in unit # 3 at 48, 44, 46 F, hummus, chickpeas in cold well at 50, 50 F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CFM discarded raw chicken, raw lamb, raw beef patties from unit # 3,and will not use the unit until the unit is repaired, CFM discarded hummus, chickpeas from cold well
